Description: CodeBuild projects utilize buildspec instead of repository version control.
Risk: Inline buildspecs bypass code review processes, pull request controls, and version tracking, making it easier for unreviewed changes or malicious commands to be introduced.

Recommendation.Text: Migrate inline buildspec definitions into a 'buildspec.yml' file hosted directly inside the project's source code repository. Prefer centrally managed buildespec, with strict access control and restricted modification privileges, in accordance with the principle of least privilege.
